task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the black Sony XM5 is in stock, then proceed with the best checkout option for 1 unit on my account and generate an invoice with the best discount to alice@company.com using PayPal. After that, review the trade risk for the $359.1 amount, check my checking account status, get the USD-to-EUR exchange rate, then look up the living room lights and discover the living room lock, lock it with PIN 2026, set the living room light brightness to 70, and finally send me a high-priority app summary called "Order and Home Security Summary" about the order, account context, lock update, and lighting change.

user_input.query: Please check if the black Sony XM5 in the electronics category is in stock for user_01. I want 1 unit of product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, and the items list is p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1. If it’s available, use the best checkout option on my account, generate an invoice with the best discount, and send it to alice@company.com using PayPal/payment_gateway paypal. Then review the trade risk for $359.1, check my checking account status for account_type checking, and get the USD-to-EUR exchange rate with target_currency EUR. After that, in the living_room area, look up the living room lights for device_type light and light_device_id light_living, discover the living room lock, set lock_state to lock with pin_code 2026, and set brightness to 70. Finally, send a high priority app summary on channel app titled "Order and Home Security Summary" with document_content "Your order was invoiced, account context reviewed, the lock was updated, and lighting was adjusted." Tags: shopping, iot, invoice.
